svg.text: Progressive Adaptive Residual Refinement for two-speaker separation on Libri2Mix 16 kHz
four stages; the same structure is instantiated at every scale
8 heads; shared by Global Transformers at all scales
one shared module at all five scales
Physical layout folds speaker into batch:
stage order is D₀ → D₁ → D₂ → D₃; processing inside each stage is shown left-to-right
Apply after all Global / Local / Cross-Speaker blocks of every decoder stage.
The refined Hr′ feeds the next stage; shared temporal core + stage-specific Normr and γr.
Auxiliary feature list captured before D₀...D₃: {SS(hB), H₀, H₁, H₂}
Main training loss: time-domain PIT SI-SNR
Auxiliary loss: multi-scale STFT-magnitude PIT SI-SNR
The temporal core is shared across all stages and speaker branches; only Normr and γr are stage-specific.
No Zr + Rr inside the temporal core; exact identity at initialization follows from γr = 0.
B: batch size · J: speakers (=2) · N: waveform samples
F: separator channels (=128) · T₀: encoder frames
Tp: padded frames · r: decoder stage index
